facts.fact: Ch 17 is about day ten of the bond (not day twenty), matching F512 (six days roped at ch 13) and F517. Kunal has watched Ila's hands and field book for ten days; the petition margin shows ten strokes and twenty-five empty places of the thirty-five days to the Meadow Cairn's meltwater. Supersedes the day-twenty count in F525 and F712 and the 'three ways in twenty days' in F710.

The storm caught Ila and Kunal about an hour east of the shelf above the Drum; the Eye lay half a night's ice ahead with no roof, so they turned back west to Dhanu's upper hut above the Mirror (F515), the nearest shelter.
At the door Kunal pulls off his gloves to show Ila his dead grey right fingertips, the price of his broken promise (F555), as proof he has nothing hidden about the Eye.
